title: Fixing export
subtitle: What interviews, a usability test and a funnel told us, and what we're building first.

slides.title: Fixing export
slides.subtitle: What interviews, a usability test and a funnel told us, and what we're building first.
slides.notes: Twenty minutes. Research first, then the numbers, then the plan. Stop me on any slide.

slides.text: People can't find export, and when they do, their dates break.
slides.notes: Both halves came up in every source. The rest of the deck is the evidence.

slides.title: Themes across six interviews
slides.source: Sample data, made up for this example

steps.say: Five of six people couldn't find export.
Half didn't trust the totals once they had them.
